scope_note: Sources establish SAT restricted to affine subspaces and structural control of mixed tractable languages. They do not prove a universal polynomial Horn-affine composer or resolve P versus NP.

sources.title: CNF Satisfiability in a Subspace and Related Problems
sources.role: Primary alignment for satisfiability restricted to an affine subspace and dimension-parameterized algorithms.

sources.title: Discovering Archipelagos of Tractability for Constraint Satisfaction and Counting
sources.role: Primary context for controlling interaction among individually tractable constraint languages.

sources.title: On SAT Representations of XOR Constraints
sources.role: Primary warning that compiling general XOR structure into CNF while retaining strong propagation can require nontrivial representation growth.

sources.title: SAT Backdoors: Depth Beats Size
sources.role: Primary context that recursive semantic distance to tractable classes may be more informative than flat variable-set size.
